coverage.source: Stats block of full-repo-quality-reports/gosec.json from Full-repo quality gate run 32878651576 (conclusion success, head_sha eb182d713589aea540767e4d8f2060e313729c7a, runner macos-15). The gosec version rests on the workflow pin at .github/workflows/full-repo-quality.yml:85 (go install github.com/securego/gosec/v2/cmd/gosec@v2.28.0), NOT on the report: the artifact's own GosecVersion field reads 'dev', which is what a go install of a tagged module reports without ldflags. standalone_gosec.actionable_rule_counts_source: Confirmed, not moved. These counts were hand-measured at 7d20556d, before scripts/gosec-repeat-run.sh existed (first commit 048ffd7d), so they predate the two-run agreement check. Re-derived from two independent gate artifacts, both produced by the wrapper: run 32908360871 (head_sha 74d04a8fd4e11ab92bd9c2bdc24d391a918d0d4e, runner macos-15) and run 32902785030 (conclusion success, head_sha 52d6bd2dba423eeb155f3600988aa82058024d1a, runner macos-15). Run 32908360871's overall conclusion is failure, and that does not disqualify it: its step 'Run standalone gosec twice and apply known-noise policy' concluded success and the failure is step 'Run aggregate race suite', which runs after gosec and cannot alter its report; the upload step is if: always() and concluded success. Verify with gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/32908360871/jobs. All four reports (gosec.json and gosec-repeat.json from each run) are byte-identical, sha256 54bc99a30e1436e2b6ee5d53e3e1c7e9bc2b76f922821ae7b97f4ab237a3266c: 210 raw findings, of which the four enumerated known_noise G404 sites strip to 206, and every rule below equals its committed value exactly. No entry carries slack -- G104 and G404 sit at 0 as floors, and every non-zero entry is an equality, so a single new finding of any rule is an increase. Usable against the tree this lands on because neither the scan input nor the producer changed between the artifact's head_sha and this change's parent 9c970547: git diff --name-only 74d04a8f 9c970547 | grep -c '\.go$' -> 0 (control: the same command over f5e2b7cd..9c970547 -> 443), and that diff's full 19 paths are all under .claude/, .nanite/, TASKS/ or docs/, plus lefthook.yml -- it touches neither .github/workflows/full-repo-quality.yml nor scripts/gosec-repeat-run.sh, so the gosec invocation that produced this report is the one the committed gate still runs. The gosec version rests on the workflow pin, not on the report, for the same reason recorded in coverage.source above. Re-derive from a gate run's artifact before moving these, never from a local gosec.
